newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann Q1 telecom sales rise 69 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann Q1 telecom sales rise 69 pct.

text.p: Germany's Mannesmann AG said on Tuesday telecommunications sales in the first quarter of 1997 rose 69 percent to 1.4 billion marks ($822.1 million), sparked by growth in mobile phone services.
Preliminary results showed first-quarter revenue from its D2 mobile phone network rose 42 percent, the company said without providing further details.

Mannesmann Arcor, a venture formed last summer with the telecom network of German railway Deutsche Bahn AG, saw first quarter sales reach 200 million marks, chief executive Joachim Funk said at a news conference.
The company also saw first-quarter growth in its automotive technology unit and tubes and trading business, while engineering orders declined one percent compared to the first quarter of 1996.
Automotive orders rose 15 percent in the January-March period and tubes and trading orders 22 percent. Engineering orders were damped by seasonal factors, Funk said.
Group sales in the quarter rose 14 percent to 8.2 billion marks and group orders climbed 13 percent to 10.2 billion marks.
-- Neal Boudette, Bonn Newsroom, +49-228 260 97 150 ($ = 1.703 German Marks)
